body:
Some pieces ask you to conform to them. This one doesn't. The Solid Copper Braided Ring is an open, adjustable cuff, hand-finished with a twisted rope texture that catches the light from every angle — and because it's open-ended, it flexes to fit almost any finger, making it one of the most versatile pieces in your rotation.

What sets this design apart is its double magnetic point — one embedded at each end of the band. Where a single point offers a steady anchor, two work together to create a fuller circuit of energy across the hand, amplifying the natural conductivity that copper is known for. It's the same grounding, energy-supportive material you know and love, just turned up.

The braided texture isn't just visual interest — it's a nod to the idea of intertwined energy, of things working better together. Wear it alone for a bold, sculptural statement, or stack it with your Formula Rings and other copper pieces to let it do what copper does best: amplify whatever it touches. This is the ring for the person who wants their jewelry to work as hard as their intentions do.

Because the band is adjustable, sizing is simple — gently open or close the cuff to fit your finger, and it'll stay right where you put it. The high-shine finish means it pairs as easily with your everyday stack as it does with something a little more special. Low-maintenance, high-frequency, and made to be worn often.
